limitations: This is a deterministic seed-0 fixed-checkpoint pilot, not a random perturbation sample.
The sign-restoring stratum has one eligible edge and is a case study, not replicated evidence.
All scenarios use one generated graph and one split.
No retraining, robustness, or stability conclusion is supported.
